body:
Me and my friend were hanging out at this girls house one day around 6:00.  I had been working, I landscape so I come across some crazy things sometimes, but this time was the craziest.  I had found 3 bags of heroin on the job site and kept them.  At my the girls house I asked if both would like to do some with me.  We all decided to do some together, and I dumped 2 of the 3 bags out.  As I dumped them out we all got nervous.  The girl went first, and she's hot so it was kind of cool to see her do it.  Then I went followed by my other friend. We all got up after doing the line each and walked around.  Within 30 seconds I could feel my body get heavy and I felt like I was on 20 oxycottons.
I can't remember much of the night.  I remember one of the friends that I did it with making me go for a ride with him and we went to an empty parking lot, sat there for 15 minutes for some reason and then drove back.  It took us forever to get back, as we kept passing the street then driving back then passing it again.  It seemed like I was about to throw up and all speech was slurred and in slow motion.  When we got back there was so many people there.  She started to throw a party.  Of course the girl that we did it with told someone there and that bugged me out badly.  I went inside, fell on the couch and just sunk my hands into my face.  As I attempted to talk to these 2 hot ass girls, I stumbled words and it was impossible to hold conversation with me.

]
Next thing I knew I was up and out of the house and driving home for some reason.  I couldn't keep my eyes open as they kept shutting on their own.  I kept seeing rear lights in front of my car, yet they were miles up the road.  I was so messed up I didn't know what to do.  I was so messed up that I wasn't even scared of the cops or anything.  I will never do this drug again.
